fixes.from: After Lexington and Concord the British were forced back to Boston and Amerian militia gather around the city to keep pressure on British forces.  The first major battle of the war begins when British troops crossed Boston Harbor by boat to attack American militia soldiers holding the high ground at Breed's Hill. Even though the British were victorious, they lost over 1,000 soldiers and realized the war would not be easy to win.

fixes.from: After leaving Boston, the British regrouped in Halifax, Nova Scotia. Next, they launched a large attack on New York City, an important port city, with the help of many Loyalist supporters in the area. During the Battle of Brooklyn, British troops outmanuevered Washinton's army by moving around the sides of the American defenses to attack where they were unprepared. The Americans were forced to retreat but kept fighting.
